components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The square Signal Green action used for primary form submission.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink); background: var(--accent); font: 700 .8125rem/1 var(--font-chakra-petch), Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .2s ease, background .2s ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: none; }

components.name: Light Header Button
components.description: The compact Cold Paper conversion action that persists in the fixed header.
components.css: .ds-button-light { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); font: 700 .75rem/1 var(--font-chakra-petch), Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform .2s ease; } .ds-button-light:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-light:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A restrained secondary action with a hairline light boundary.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28); border-radius: 0; color: var(--paper); background: rgba(255,255,255,.03); font: 700 .8125rem/1 var(--font-chakra-petch), Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform .2s ease, border-color .2s ease; } .ds-button-outline:hover { border-color: var(--paper); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Luminous Action Link
components.description: The signature conversion action with restrained, state-driven orbital glow.
components.html: JOIN WAITING LIST
components.css: .ds-glow-link { position: relative; min-height: 48px; padding: 2px; display: inline-flex; isolation: isolate; color: var(--paper); font: 700 .8125rem/1 var(--font-chakra-petch), Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform .2s ease; } .ds-glow-link__field { position: absolute; z-index: -1; inset: -6px; overflow: hidden; opacity: .13; filter: blur(5px); background: conic-gradient(from 10deg, var(--accent-dark) 0 14%, transparent 23% 43%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 54%, var(--paper)) 54% 66%, transparent 76% 91%, var(--accent-dark) 100%); animation: ds-glow-orbit 3.8s cubic-bezier(.56,.15,.28,.86) infinite paused; } .ds-glow-link__surface { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: linear-gradient(115deg, rgba(255,255,255,.08), transparent 42%), var(--accent); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(10,12,11,.18); } .ds-glow-link:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-glow-link:hover .ds-glow-link__field, .ds-glow-link:focus-visible .ds-glow-link__field { opacity: 1; animation-play-state: running; } .ds-glow-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; } @keyframes ds-glow-orbit { from { transform: rotate(10deg) scale(1); } 50% { transform: rotate(190deg) scale(.78); } to { transform: rotate(370deg) scale(1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-glow-link__field { animation: none; } }

components.name: Underline Input
components.description: Transparent form field with a single field-colored rule and Signal Green focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; color: var(--control-muted); font: 700 .6875rem/1 var(--font-chakra-petch), Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field__input { width: 100%; padding: 16px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(220,237,219,.16); border-radius: 0; outline: 0; color: var(--surface-alternate-text); caret-color: var(--accent); background: transparent; font: 200 1.25rem/1.3 var(--font-crimson-pro), Georgia, serif; text-transform: none; } .ds-field__input:focus { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-field__input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: A compact Carbon Ink bar with the geometric mark, restrained navigation, and persistent conversion action.
components.html: KIPORYLET'S TALKJOIN WAITING LIST
components.css: .ds-nav { min-height: 72px; padding: 0 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 28px; color: var(--paper); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 72%, transparent); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); font: 700 .8125rem/1 var(--font-chakra-petch), Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav__brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; letter-spacing: .16em; } .ds-nav__brand svg { width: 25px; color: var(--accent); } .ds-nav__brand path { stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.6; } .ds-nav__actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; } .ds-nav__actions > a:first-child { color: var(--text-secondary); } .ds-nav__actions > a:first-child:hover { color: var(--paper); } .ds-nav__cta { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; color: var(--ink) !important; background: var(--paper); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Success Panel
components.description: The in-place operational acknowledgment shown after form submission.
components.html:
MESSAGE SENT

WE'LL TAKE IT FROM HERE.

Our team will review your note and follow up by email.
components.css: .ds-success { position: relative; min-height: 320px; padding: clamp(34px,4vw,58px); display: grid; align-content: center; gap: 18px; overflow: hidden; color: var(--surface-alternate-text); background: linear-gradient(285deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 14%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-alternate) 78%, transparent) 56%), color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-alternate) 72%, transparent); border-block: 1px solid var(--surface-alternate-line); } .ds-success::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 1px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, var(--accent) 30%, var(--accent) 70%, transparent); } .ds-success__status { margin: 0; color: var(--accent); font: 700 .6875rem/1 var(--font-chakra-petch), Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-success h2 { max-width: 13ch; margin: 0; color: var(--surface-alternate-text); font: 300 clamp(2.5rem,4.4vw,4.5rem)/.95 var(--font-outfit), Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-success__body { max-width: 44ch; margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--surface-alternate-muted); font: 200 1.3rem/1.3 var(--font-crimson-pro), Georgia, serif; } .ds-success__mark { position: absolute; top: 32px; right: 32px; width: 72px; fill: none; stroke: var(--accent); stroke-width: 1.25; opacity: .28; } .ds-success:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-capability { min-height: 132px; padding: 28px 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 52px minmax(0,1fr); gap: 22px; color: var(--paper); border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(220,237,219,.16); } .ds-capability__count { width: 30px; height: 30px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font: 700 1rem/1 var(--font-chakra-petch), Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-capability h3 { margin: 0; font: 300 1.375rem/1.2 var(--font-chakra-petch), Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .03rem; } .ds-capability__accent { margin: .15em 0 0; color: var(--accent); font: 300 1.125rem/1.2 var(--font-chakra-petch), Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-capability p:last-child { max-width: 520px; margin: 12px 0 0; color: var(--surface-alternate-muted); font: 200 1.3rem/1.3 var(--font-crimson-pro), Georgia, serif; }

components.name: Flow Node
components.description: The flat-3D geometric unit used throughout horizontal, vertical, and hero process illustrations.
components.css: .ds-flow-field { position: relative; width: 260px; height: 150px; overflow: hidden; background-color: var(--ink); background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(57,71,63,.28) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(57,71,63,.28) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 30px 30px; } .ds-flow-route { position: absolute; left: 22px; top: 74px; width: 210px; border-top: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.66); } .ds-flow-node { position: absolute; left: 106px; top: 48px; width: 54px; height: 54px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #066b43, #03492b 52%, #052f24); border: 1px solid var(--paper); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 35%), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 16%); } .ds-flow-node svg { width: 26px; fill: none; stroke: var(--paper); stroke-width: 1.25; } .ds-flow-signal { position: absolute; left: 185px; top: 70px; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--packet-core, #f1fbf0); box-shadow: 0 0 5px 2px var(--accent), 0 0 20px 8px rgba(68,156,64,.42); }

narrative.overview:
Kipory presents complex business processes as a precise operational field that is visibly alive. Carbon-dark surfaces hold measured grids, dashed routes, geometric nodes, and small bursts of Signal Green; the interface feels exact and restrained until motion reveals that data is actively moving through it. The system is technical without becoming sterile and kinetic without becoming noisy.

The visual language favors crisp edges, asymmetric information layouts, hairline structure, and low-luminance tonal layering. Large, light display typography provides calm authority while serif body text keeps technical explanations readable and human. Soft rounded SaaS containers are an anti-reference; brighter technical graphics remain welcome when they explain flow, state, or depth.
keyCharacteristics: Carbon-dark fields punctuated by a single operational green.
Blueprint grids, dashed connectors, and geometric flow nodes used as real information-bearing imagery.
A three-voice type system: calm display, human body, precise control.
Flat surfaces at rest, with glow and shadow reserved for activity, focus, and illustrated depth.
Square controls and hairline borders instead of soft cards or decorative chrome.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Green owns action, focus, active flow, and brand recognition. Do not introduce a second global accent.

rules.name: The Dark Field Rule
rules.body: Product marketing surfaces begin from Carbon Ink or Signal Field; light values are content and signal, not page backgrounds.

rules.name: The Diagram Exception Rule
rules.body: Flow illustrations may become brighter and more chromatic when the added color communicates depth, direction, or activity.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Outfit states the idea, Crimson Pro explains it, and Chakra Petch operates it. Do not substitute one role for another merely for emphasis.

rules.name: The Light Authority Rule
rules.body: Display hierarchy comes from scale and spacing, not heavy font weight; primary headings remain light.

rules.name: The Structured Asymmetry Rule
rules.body: Give one side of a composition clear visual authority, then align the quieter side to its content—not to an arbitrary centered card.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Alive Rule
rules.body: Surfaces remain flat until state or illustrated physics justifies depth.

rules.name: The Shape-Has-a-Job Rule
rules.body: A circle signals utility or activity; a hexagon or node silhouette communicates topology; everything else stays crisp and square.

dos: Do use Signal Green for actions, focus, live flow, and state changes—not for broad decorative fills.
Do keep large surfaces square and let hairlines, tonal layers, and spacing create hierarchy.
Do preserve the Outfit / Crimson Pro / Chakra Petch role split.
Do use brighter greens, highlights, and dimensional shading inside technical illustrations when they clarify movement or depth.
Do pair motion with a useful event and provide a reduced-motion equivalent.
Do keep body copy readable against dark fields and within a controlled measure.
donts: Don't introduce soft rounded cards, pill-shaped primary actions, or generic dashboard containers.
Don't replace the dark operational palette with a bright SaaS canvas.
Don't apply persistent glow or shadow to static content.
Don't use blueprint grids when the surface has no process, measurement, or workflow meaning.
Don't replace authored flow diagrams with generic stock illustration or decorative icon tiles.
